name: GiftScope
tagline: Holiday gift ideas kids actually want, sorted by age, interest and budget.

ages.label: Babies
ages.title: Best Gifts for Babies (0–12 Months)
ages.intro: Play gyms, activity centers and sensory toys that babies use every day. Every pick is rated 4.5 stars or higher on Amazon and safe for the first year.

ages.label: Toddlers
ages.title: Best Gifts for 1- and 2-Year-Olds
ages.intro: Toddlers want to push, stack, press and copy grown-ups. These are the sturdy, well-loved toys that survive that stage, from first-word books to ride-on cars.

ages.label: Preschoolers
ages.title: Best Gifts for 3- and 4-Year-Olds

ages.label: Kids 5–7

ages.intro: Early-grade kids are ready for real LEGO sets, first science kits, scooters and RC cars. These picks match their growing skills without frustration.

ages.label: Kids 8–12
ages.title: Best Gifts for Kids Ages 8 to 12
ages.intro: Tweens want gifts that feel grown-up: engineering kits, Technic and Speed Champions sets, instant cameras, gadgets and games for the whole family.

ages.label: Teens
ages.title: Best Gifts for Teens
